description_en: Handles an AccessKey pair leak record
name: ModifyAccessKeyLeakDeal

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AccessKey pair leak record.
Call the [DescribeAccesskeyLeakList](~~DescribeAccesskeyLeakList~~) operation to obtain this parameter. This parameter and the IdList parameter cannot both be empty
parameters.help_zh:
AccessKey泄露记录ID。
调用[DescribeAccesskeyLeakList](~~DescribeAccesskeyLeakList~~)接口可以获取该参数，与IdList参数不能同时为空
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The method to handle the AccessKey pair leak information. Valid values:
manual: Manual handling.
disable: Disable.
add-whitelist: Add to whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
AccessKey泄露信息的处理方式。取值：
manual：手动处理
disable：禁用
add-whitelist：加入白名单
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The remarks for handling the AccessKey pair leak record
parameters.help_zh: AccessKey泄露记录处理的备注信息
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the AccessKey pair leak records
parameters.name: id_list

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
